subject.title: fix(compaction): retain CJK sessions within token budget

question: Should OpenClaw support `@openclaw/normalization-core/cjk-chars` as a public reusable subpath for standalone agent-core rather than keeping the estimator root-runtime-only?
rationale: The functional bug fix is focused and validated, but the added export and plugin-SDK declaration inventory make the helper a durable package contract that cannot be treated as an internal-only refactor.

options.title: Accept the shared subpath
options.body: Treat the CJK estimator as supported normalization-core API and merge the compaction fix with its current package-boundary coverage.

options.title: Keep the contract internal
options.body: Ask for a revised shared internal/package entry arrangement that lets agent-core reuse the estimator without establishing this public subpath.

recommendation.title: Accept the shared subpath
recommendation.body: Treat the CJK estimator as supported normalization-core API and merge the compaction fix with its current package-boundary coverage.
